statusNote: Design and local evidence are complete for Control Plane review. Not signable until every entry in unresolvedInputs is supplied by a named human and phase G2 empirical checks pass. Nothing in this file has been applied.
designChanges: Rollback of Save/Attention is a Cloud Run traffic pin to the pre-recorded baseline revision. No Cloud Functions update, source rebuild, Cloud Build launch or Functions IAM is used or requested.
The Cloud Build release worker identity (pmdash-pr54-release), the build-launch role and actAs on the compute/source-build identity are removed from the watchdog design.
Only one runtime identity is created: the Workflows execution identity.

cloudRun.request: PATCH https://run.googleapis.com/v2/projects/{project}/locations/us-central1/services/{service}?updateMask=traffic (preceded by the same request with validateOnly=true)
documentedBehaviour: Traffic rollback applies immediately and does not re-run deployment health checks (Cloud Run rollouts documentation). Functional proof therefore comes only from the authenticated legacy receipt.
Traffic pinned to a named revision persists for later deployments (same documentation). A later Functions deploy must explicitly re-point traffic; see postDrillObligations.

controls: Granted only on the two allowlisted services; cannot touch the PDF service or any other service or function.
Workflow definition is the only caller; the runtime identity cannot edit the workflow (no workflows.workflows.update); definition reviewed and static-tested to emit only updateMask=traffic.

Deployers need Artifact Registry read to deploy an image (Google guidance); that role is deliberately withheld, so an image-changing update should fail. Confirmed or refuted at G2 with a validateOnly negative test; the claim is NOT relied upon until then.

Cloud Audit Logs Admin Activity (always on) records every UpdateService by the watchdog; alerting on any such event while no release is armed. Whether the logged request exposes updateMask is checked at G2.
Bindings exist only for the drill window and are removed by the setup operator afterward (cleanup).
UAT project only; Production never bound.
Workflow can only release a manifest-pinned finalized Hosting version and a manifest-pinned ruleset; both are read from an immutable, generation-pinned manifest.
G1 read-only inventory confirms the number of Hosting sites in the project; more than one site => STOP.
Admin Activity alerts on Hosting release creation and Rules release update outside an armed release.
